labels: SST-for-bottom-T proxy: annual SST applied to a Q4 bottom-T knob; deep warming runs higher than SST in ventilated basins, so the herring decline is likely UNDERSTATED.
Summer-only + SLR-variant delta-O2 (Meier2022 Table 10) applied year-round.
Uniform-offset spatial blindness + floor asymmetry: the additive O2 offset is spatially uniform and floor-clipped on the negative side but uncapped on the positive side.
LTL-at-baseline: the BSAP cells are a partial-load world -- the load cut's O2 benefit enters but its plankton/nutrient pathways do not; the omitted pathways plausibly oppose the included one.

Reference-period overstatement (spec decision 5): literature deltas are end-century vs 1976-2005 but applied raw on a present-day baseline (O2: 2024 analysis; tref: 1993-2021 mean) -- overstates end-century forcing by the realized 1976-2005->present component.
cod_east's trajectory is partly prescribed by the RV narrative series (gate factor 0.32-0.87 across the scored decade) -- its scenario deltas are conditioned on that prescription.
